versions.content: Crypto_CustomService returns the actual error value of the KeyM_CertificateVerify If Crypto_ProcessJob() is called for an asyn- chronous job configured with service CUSTOM_SERVICE that is mapped from a KeyM API that will trigger KeyM_CertificateVerifyCallbackNotification() and if E_OK or CRYPTO_E_CUSTOM_ERROR will be returned in the Crypto_ResultType pa- rameter, then uint8* secondaryOutputPtr shall contain the appropriate value from Crypto_KeyM_CertificateStatusType data type.
